Title: Privacy Policy Page — Structure & Styling
Summary: Authoritative reference for the privacy-policy.html page: structure, content sections, and privacy-specific CSS styles.
Content:
## Overview

The privacy policy page (`privacy-policy.html`) is a lightweight, static legal page that explains how the Cyréna website handles visitor data. It reuses the shared site architecture (header, footer, navigation, hero, and content sections) and adds a small set of privacy-specific styles.

## HTML Structure

- `<header class="site-header">` — shared sticky header (see `cyr-001`).
- `<section class="hero hero-small">` — smaller hero with "Privacy Policy" heading and subtitle.
- `<section class="privacy-section">` — "Overview" — brief statement that the site is static and does not collect personal data.
- `<section class="privacy-section alt-bg">` — "What We Collect" — lists what the site does not use (analytics, ads, third-party embeds, logins) and notes standard server access logs.
- `<section class="privacy-section">` — "Cookies" — states the site does not set cookies.
- `<section class="privacy-section alt-bg">` — "Third-Party Services" — confirms no third-party scripts, fonts, or trackers are loaded.
- `<section class="privacy-section">` — "Contact" — email link for privacy questions.
- `<footer class="site-footer">` — shared footer (see `cyr-001`).

## Key Components

### Hero Small
- Reuses `.hero-small` from the about page styles (see `cyr-003`).
- Heading: "Privacy Policy".
- Subtitle: "How Cyréna handles data and respects your privacy."

### Privacy Sections
- `.privacy-section` uses the same spacing and typography conventions as `.content-section`:
  - `padding-block: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem)`
  - Left-aligned headings with `clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem)`
  - Body text: `1rem`, `color: var(--color-text-secondary)`, `line-height: 1.7`, `max-width: 70ch`
- `.alt-bg` alternates to `--color-surface` for visual rhythm.
- Unordered lists use `list-style: disc` with `padding-left: 1.5rem` and `gap: 0.75rem`.
- Links inside `.privacy-section` use `color: var(--color-accent)` with underline and hover transition to `var(--color-accent-hover)`.

## Accessibility
- Sections use `aria-labelledby` pointing to their heading.
- Skip link targets `#main-content`.
- Semantic landmarks: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`.

## Asset References
- `css/styles.css`
- `js/main.js`
- Page links back to `index.html` with hash anchors and `about.html`.
